title: AEOeye vs Nightwatch: AI Visibility Tracking Compared (2026)
metaTitle: AEOeye vs Nightwatch: AI Visibility Compared
metaDescription: AEOeye vs Nightwatch compared: free instant AI visibility check across 5 engines vs an SEO rank tracker with a paid AI add-on. See pricing, speed, and best
shortAnswer: AEOeye is a free, instant AI visibility audit: it asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini the questions your buyers ask and shows whether they recommend you. Nightwatch is a mature SEO rank tracker that bolts on AI visibility as a paid beta add-on (roughly $99+/mo on top of its base plan, no free tier). Pick AEOeye for a fast no-setup answer; pick Nightwatch if you already do keyword rank tracking and want AI inside that same workflow.
intro:
Both tools tell you how AI engines talk about your brand, but they come at it from opposite directions. AEOeye is purpose-built around one question — *do ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini recommend my brand?* — and answers it for free, instantly, with no setup. Nightwatch is a 13-year-old SEO rank-tracking platform that recently added an AI-visibility module so SEO teams can track AI mentions inside the same dashboard they already use for keyword rankings.

This page lays out the honest trade-offs: pricing, engine coverage, speed, setup effort, and who each tool actually fits. Nightwatch is genuinely stronger on traditional SEO data and reporting; AEOeye is faster and simpler for a non-expert who just wants to know where they stand in AI answers today.

sections.heading: What each tool is built for
sections.body:
**AEOeye** is a dedicated AI-visibility (AEO/GEO) tool. You enter your brand, it runs the prompts real buyers type, queries five AI engines blind, and shows whether each one recommends you, where you rank, and which competitors win the answer. There's no SEO project to configure and no rank-tracking baggage — the entire product is the AI question.

**Nightwatch** is first and foremost an SEO rank tracker, built on 13+ years of ranking data, covering 100,000+ locations and 190+ countries. Its AI-visibility module is a newer addition layered on top: it simulates user prompts to ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity (plus AI Overviews on Google, Bing, and YouTube) and reports visibility score, share of voice, sentiment, and citations.

So the core difference is altitude. Nightwatch sits inside a full SEO platform — powerful if you live in keyword tracking, heavier if you don't. AEOeye sits at exactly one job and tries to make it instant and obvious. If your team already runs Nightwatch for rankings, adding its AI module keeps everything in one place. If you don't do rank tracking at all, much of Nightwatch is surface area you won't use.

sections.heading: Pricing and free access
sections.body:
This is the sharpest split. **AEOeye is free to start** — you can run a real AI-visibility audit and get an answer without a trial clock, a credit card, or a contract. Its deeper multi-engine querying activates with usage, so the more you use it, the more depth you unlock.

**Nightwatch has no free tier and no free instant audit** — only a 14-day trial. Its headline rank-tracking price is cheap (roughly $32/mo on annual billing), but AI visibility is a separate beta add-on. Reported pricing varies by region and billing cycle, but reviewers consistently describe the AI add-on as starting around +$99/mo and scaling toward ~$495/mo, metered by prompt volume. In practice the realistic minimum to actually track AI lands near $131+/mo once you combine the base plan and the add-on — roughly 2.5x the advertised entry price.

The honest read: if your budget is for AI visibility specifically, Nightwatch costs meaningfully more than its sticker suggests. If you're already paying for Nightwatch's rank tracking, the incremental cost is easier to justify. AEOeye removes the cost question from the first answer entirely.

sections.heading: Engine coverage and depth
sections.body:
**AEOeye queries five engines** — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini — and does it blind, so results aren't skewed by your own logged-in history. The output is framed around buyer questions: who gets recommended, your rank, and which competitors win.

**Nightwatch commonly covers four** — ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity — plus AI Overview tracking on Google, Bing, and YouTube, which is a real plus if Google's AI Overviews matter to you. Its AI module reports the standard metrics (visibility score, share of voice, sentiment, citations).

Where Nightwatch is honestly weaker on the AI side: multiple reviewers describe it as "a rank tracker with AI tracking bolted on," with the AI features still labeled beta and called basic versus dedicated GEO/AEO platforms. Prompt caps can feel tight if you have a broad prompt library. Where AEOeye is honest about its own limits: it's newer and lighter on enterprise analytics and long historical dashboards than an incumbent like Nightwatch — its strength is breadth of engines and speed to a clear answer, not 13 years of trend data.

sections.heading: Setup, speed, and learning curve
sections.body:
**AEOeye is built for a non-expert to get an answer in one sitting.** No SEO project, no keyword import, no dashboard configuration — you ask, it queries the engines, you see whether AI recommends you. Speed to first result is the whole point.

**Nightwatch carries a real setup and learning curve** precisely because it's a full SEO platform. Reviewers report friction configuring advanced views, dashboards, and reports, and because AI data lives inside an SEO tool, getting useful AI-visibility insight benefits from ongoing SEO expertise. For an SEO professional that depth is a feature; for someone who just wants a quick yes/no on AI recommendations, it's friction before the answer.

That said, Nightwatch rewards the investment. Once configured, you get white-label reports, granular location/language targeting, and AI visibility sitting next to your rank data — a genuinely integrated view that a single-purpose tool can't match. The trade is time and expertise up front. AEOeye trades away that depth to deliver an answer in minutes.

sections.heading: Which one should you choose?
sections.body:
**Choose AEOeye if** you want a fast, honest answer to one question with zero commitment: do ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini recommend my brand, and who beats me? It's ideal for founders, marketers, and non-experts who want to see where they stand today, across five engines, for free — and grow into deeper querying as they use it.

**Choose Nightwatch if** you already do (or want to start) serious keyword rank tracking and prefer AI visibility inside that same SEO workflow rather than as a separate tool. If you value 13 years of ranking data, Google AI Overview tracking, white-label agency reporting, and unlimited seats, Nightwatch's depth is real — just budget for the AI add-on on top of the base plan, and expect setup time.

Many teams will run both: AEOeye for the instant, free pulse-check across engines, and Nightwatch for ongoing SEO-plus-AI tracking once they've decided AI visibility is worth a paid, configured platform. They're not strictly either/or — they sit at different points on the speed-versus-depth curve.
